Rob Dyrdek spent $1.8 million of his own money on a skateboard movie. Years later it sent him a check for $17.

He was tired of Hollywood making skateboarding look stupid. So he decided to make his own feature film.

He wrote it with a friend at his house in San Diego. 4 months of pacing and firing dialogue.

The agent read it.

"It's too core. This would never work."

A producer friend put together a budget.

$750,000.

"I ended up spending $1.8 million of my own money. Never got any help. Never asked for help."

The movie was rated R. Nobody would distribute it.

"I don't win unless this thing's in theaters."

So he paid to put it in 30 theaters himself. Then went on a nationwide tour doing signings in every city.

Years later he was going through his finances for the month. One entry said Street Dreams.

$17.

A check for iTunes sales.

"This is major."

Rather than relying on ideological supporters, the Lebanese militant group is allegedly targeting criminals struggling financially, offering them money and sending them to Lebanon for training.

The operation was uncovered through Brazil's Operation Trapiche investigation, launched in November 2023 with assistance from Israel's Mossad.

One suspect, Lucas Passos Lima, allegedly traveled to Lebanon twice before returning to Brazil and filming three synagogues, a Jewish cemetery, the Israeli embassy and a rabbi near Brasília.

Investigators also uncovered suspected weapons training, covert communications and financial networks involving Brazilian businesses.

In a separate case, a São Paulo cryptocurrency broker is accused of creating digital wallets for Hezbollah and the IRGC to facilitate money laundering and terrorism financing.

The suspected strategy is to use ordinary criminals as operatives, making potential attacks appear to be isolated acts of violence rather than coordinated terrorist operations.

Pope Leo XIV to the student athletes of Villanova University and the University of Notre Dame:

“No one is born a champion, just as no one is born a saint. Rather, holiness requires a daily training in love. In this regard, Christians are called to run in the race of life, but the objective of winning an imperishable crown of glory.
